criteria.requirement: Implement feedgen.publish.write_feed(feed,destination,*,format="atom",pretty=False) and frozen FeedArtifact(format,size,sha256). Serialize entire actual Atom/RSS or completed JSON Feed to UTF8 before touching target, preserve completed Atom link metadata including zero-length string values. Write same-dir temp, flush/fsync and atomic replace; retain existing regular file permissions. Invalid feed, serialization/write/replace failure must retain old file and remove temp. Reject unknown formats and symlink/nonfile output, return exact final byte count/hash only on success. Do not reimplement XML or drop registered extensions, and do not claim multiple feed files publish as one transaction.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
